var.subject: Subject

compose.fl2va: From the start frame to the end frame: {action} {where}
compose.fl2vaEnd: strict continuity between the two frames
compose.ref2vaIdentity: identity and appearance true to the references

tpl.t1.name: Slow dolly in
tpl.t1.description: Gradual approach toward the subject, no jolts.
tpl.t1.text: Slow dolly in toward {subject} in {place}, steady continuous movement over {duration}.
tpl.t2.name: Camera arc
tpl.t2.description: The camera circles the subject at a constant distance.
tpl.t2.text: A 90° camera arc around {subject}, constant distance, level horizon.
tpl.t3.name: Contemplative static shot
tpl.t3.description: Still frame, the action unfolds within the shot.
tpl.t3.text: Locked-off tripod shot on {place}. {subject} {action}, the frame does not move.
tpl.t4.name: Lateral move
tpl.t4.description: Glides parallel to the subject, parallax effect.
tpl.t4.text: Slow lateral move from left to right along {subject}, strong parallax with the foreground.
tpl.t5.name: Golden backlight
tpl.t5.description: Low sun behind the subject, warm halo.
tpl.t5.text: Golden backlight, low sun behind {subject}, warm halo on the edges, long shadows.
tpl.t6.name: Window light
tpl.t6.text: Soft window light from the left, {subject}’s face half in shadow.
tpl.t7.name: Night neons
tpl.t7.text: Night, magenta and cyan neon reflections on wet {place}, {subject} lit by the signs.
tpl.t8.name: Film noir
tpl.t8.text: Film noir look: hard contrast, sharp-edged shadows, light haze, {subject} in silhouette.
tpl.t9.name: Naturalism
tpl.t9.text: Naturalistic style, available light, true colors, subtle grain, {subject} {action} with no visible staging.
tpl.t10.name: 35 mm texture
tpl.t10.text: 35 mm film texture, fine grain, slight halation on the highlights.
tpl.t11.name: Adventure
tpl.t11.description: Wide open spaces, energy, an epic feel.
tpl.t11.text: A sense of adventure: wide open spaces, {subject} tiny in {place}, a vast sky.
tpl.t12.name: Confession
tpl.t12.text: {subject} whispers a secret, low voice, eyes that drift away then come back, emotion: {emotion}.
tpl.t13.name: Contained tension
tpl.t13.text: {subject} answers in short sentences, tense silences, the tension stays contained.
tpl.t14.name: Decision
tpl.t14.description: The moment the character makes up their mind.
tpl.t14.text: {subject} pauses, then makes the decision: {action}. Eyes straight into the lens.
tpl.t15.name: Deadpan humor
tpl.t15.text: {subject} delivers a deadpan line, straight face, a slight beat before the reaction.
tpl.t16.name: Wide angle, low horizon
tpl.t16.description: The sky dominates, the subject is small in the frame.
tpl.t16.text: 24 mm wide angle, low horizon on the lower third, {subject} small in the frame.
tpl.t17.name: Telephoto portrait
tpl.t17.text: Portrait on a {lens} telephoto, compressed blurred background, focus on {subject}’s eyes.
tpl.t18.name: Mountain ambience
tpl.t18.text: Mountain soundscape: steady wind, distant birds, a sense of space.
tpl.t19.name: Light continuity
tpl.t19.description: Keep the direction and color of the light.
tpl.t19.text: Keep the direction and color temperature of the previous shot’s light ({light}).
tpl.t20.name: Character identity
tpl.t20.text: Keep {subject}’s identity: same clothes, hair and proportions as the reference.
tpl.t21.name: No text or logo
tpl.t21.description: Keep any writing out of the picture.
tpl.t22.name: No distortion
tpl.t22.text: Avoid: distorted hands, changing faces, objects that appear or disappear.
tpl.t23.name: Contemplative opening
tpl.t23.text: Contemplative opening shot on {place} at dawn, no hurry, {subject} enters the frame after a few seconds.
tpl.p1.name: My drone flyover
tpl.p1.text: Drone flyover above {place}, slow fluid movement, slight tilt toward {subject}.
